en_how: One original child walks through four worlds drawn by four renderers on the same pose: an impasto oil painting from a flow field of brush strokes (pre-rendered once), clean anime cel shading with hard shadows, clay with soft gradient blobs, thick same-colour outlines and a fingerprint texture, and a pixel world drawn on a 1/12 canvas and upscaled without smoothing; diagonal clip-path wipes switch styles at fixed times.
